findings: Law89-01 art1 inserts the management-contract chapter into Civil BookII/TitleIX, with its own articles1-10. It does not replace Civil general provisions1-10.

Original JO page3 contains the insertion instruction and local articles1-3; page4 right contains local4-10, then the amending law publication article2 and closing signature. Page4 left begins the next law89-02, which is excluded.
The Ministry compilation places local1 on PDF101 and local2-10 onPDF102, between Civil570 and571. Its first label uses bare-alif al-ula and was missed by the older collector.

Research numberScope distinguishes main and management-contract without inventing printed bis numbers. The typed reader still needs an explicit qualified-number representation before full Civil delivery.
